ἐπί in the comparative idiom ἐπὶ πλεῖον realized by yet. Two English words stand for the pair, so rule 94 forbids a compound unit and rule 2 splits it; reading the pair as one noncompositional unit is the competing analysis and is excluded by the word count.

Aorist passive participle of the same compound; being is the supplied copula of the passive periphrasis and down realizes the preverb under rule 106, head on borne.

Supplied possessive his with no other source word present to take it, so the article realizes it under rule 20's second arm; rule 11 keeps the italics from making it added.

Inflected verb with its English subject pronoun as a rule 7 helper, head on the lexical fell under rules 9 and 17. The supplied juncture and rides inside the unit under rule 88: the ASV converted καθεζόμενος into the finite there sat, and the and it then had to write introduces this expressed finite verb, discontinuously across the intervening temporal clause under rule 15. Rule 98 does not reach it, that rule being scoped to an asyndetic seam between two like constituents both rendered alike, whereas this seam joins a converted participial clause to a finite main clause, as the ASV's own semicolon shows. Marking the word added under rule 5 was the earlier reading and is what this patch corrects.
Adverb κάτω to down; kept off ἔπεσεν, which has its own English word.
ἀπό to from.

Compound τρίστεγον rendered by two words each glossing an element; rule 66 heads the core στέγ- word story and not the numeral modifier.

Aorist passive αἴρω rendered was taken up; the auxiliary and the particle of the phrasal verb ride inside the unit, head on the lexical taken under rules 9 and 17.

review_notes: s014 is the only unrepresented token: the article before Παύλου (rule 23). A reference comparison will report it as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.

The verse now carries no added unit. The supplied and at t018 is folded onto ἔπεσεν under rule 88, as the chapter's eight other participle-to-finite junctures are (20:1, 20:3, 20:5, 20:10, 20:14, 20:17, 20:36, 20:37); the discontinuity across t019-t029 is what rule 15 permits, and no intervening word is absorbed.
Variant SBLGNT.ACT.20.9.v013 is underdetermined to r00-base and covers s001; the base is among the readings the English permits, so rule 97 is not in question and no textual decision is made here.
